title: Natalie Tan’s Book of Luck & Fortune by Roselle Lim
description:
Our Novel & Nibbles book is a warm, slightly magical story about food, family/community and healing. Natalie, an aspiring chef, returns to San Francisco’s China Town after inheriting her grandmother’s shuttered restaurant in a neighborhood that is struggling and fading. In her efforts to reopen the restaurant she discovers her grandmother’s cookbook filled with recipes meant to help her neighbors heal. A fortune teller tells her the restaurant will succeed if she cooks specific dishes from this cookbook, and as she cooks each dish, she begins to mend her community and her past.

One of the dishes brought to life from this story is Natalie’s Salted Duck Congee, a silky, slow simmered jasmine rice in rich duck broth, infused with ginger, sesame oil, and a hint of white pepper. Finished with tender braised duck, a luscious salted duck egg, fresh green onion and a whole lot of love.

Swing by and treat yourself to a bowl of comfort!
